players.product: Hyperscale data centers in China leased under binding take-or-pay commitments to China's largest hyperscalers and emerging AI companies (established tier-1 markets plus new campuses in Ulanqab and Horinger, Inner Mongolia, Shaoguan, Guangdong, and Zhongwei, Ningxia)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release (6-K Exhibit 99.1): net revenue RMB3,088.0 million (US$455.1 million), up 6.5% year over year, mainly from the continued ramp-up of its data centers; adjusted EBITDA RMB1,406.0 million (+2.5%), a 45.5% margin versus 47.3%, the decline mainly from higher utility costs as a percentage of net revenue. Net income was RMB837.6 million; share of results of equity method investees was an income of RMB959.9 million, mainly from the dilution gain on its investment in DayOne Data Centers Limited after DayOne's Series C Convertible Preferred Share issue. Operating metrics at June 30, 2026: total area committed and pre-committed 784,802 sqm (+18.2% year over year, +8.2% quarter over quarter; 59,317 sqm of gross and net additional area committed in Q2), area in service 684,977 sqm (+10.8%), area under construction 170,355 sqm (+43.9% quarter over quarter), commitment rate 92.4%, pre-commitment rate for area under construction 89.2% (84.4% at end-Q1), area utilized 542,236 sqm (+13.2%) and utilization rate 79.2% (77.5% a year earlier).
quarterly_data.figure: net revenue RMB3,088.0 million (+6.5%); adjusted EBITDA RMB1,406.0 million (45.5% margin); 784,802 sqm committed (+18.2%); utilization rate 79.2%

quarterly_data.signal: Updated 2026 guidance in the Q2 results release: total revenues RMB12,700 million-RMB13,000 million (previously RMB12,400 million-RMB12,900 million), a year-over-year increase of 11.1% to 13.7%; adjusted EBITDA RMB5,900 million-RMB6,100 million (previously RMB5,750 million-RMB6,000 million), an increase of 9.2% to 12.9%, both including the one-time items disclosed in Q1 2026; capex guidance raised from around RMB9,000 million to around RMB10,000 million, reflecting strong sales, the current sales outlook and the corresponding increase in data center development. CEO William Huang: GDS is 'on track to achieving a record sales commitment for this year, which is much higher than our original target', with opportunities in China 'driven mainly by AI demand'.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 revenue RMB12,700 million-RMB13,000 million; adjusted EBITDA RMB5,900 million-RMB6,100 million; capex ~RMB10,000 million
